title: CS-54k: A Paper-Grounded Corpus and Benchmark for AI Research QA
abstract: arXiv:2510.20279v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to support computer science research. To contribute reliably, these systems must be able to work with information distributed across research papers and across different aspects of the research process. However, large-scale resources that systematically organize such information into structured supervision for both model evaluation and post-training remain limited. To address this gap, we propose a systematic paper-to-QA construction pipeline that organizes information from AI research papers into structured QA pairs supported by source evidence. Using this pipeline, we construct CS-54k, a 54k-pair corpus derived from 14,474 openly licensed AI research papers. The corpus covers eight recurring paper components, including research domain, prior work, existing challenges, motivation, findings and assumptions, methods, experimental settings, and experimental results. translated_title: CS-54k：一个基于论文的AI研究问答语料库与基准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用于支持计算机科学研究。为了可靠地发挥作用，这些系统必须能够处理分布在研究论文中以及研究过程不同方面的信息。然而，能够将此类信息系统地组织成结构化监督、同时服务于模型评估与后训练的大规模资源仍然有限。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个系统化的“论文到问答”构建流水线，将AI研究论文中的信息组织为由来源证据支持的结构化问答对。利用该流水线，我们构建了CS-54k，这是一个包含54,000个问答对的语料库，源自14,474篇开放许可的AI研究论文。该语料库涵盖了八个常见的论文组成部分，包括研究领域、先前工作、现有挑战、研究动机、发现与假设、方法、实验设置以及实验结果。我们进一步……
tldr: 提出了CS-54k，一个从14,474篇开放许可的AI研究论文中构建的包含5.4万个问答对的语料库与基准，涵盖论文的八个核心组成部分，为AI研究问答提供了可用于模型评估与后训练的结构化监督资源。
en_tdlr: We propose CS-54k, a 54k-pair QA corpus and benchmark derived from 14,474 openly licensed AI research papers covering eight core paper components, providing a large-scale structured supervision resource for both model evaluation and post-training in AI research QA.
